messages:
alex.park: FYI support escalation from ACME — they show ~120 reserved GPU hours billed last night for pool rp-nyc-3 but token usage is tiny (4k tokens). dashboard shows ~3.8h. Can someone triage? :confused:

maria.g: ack. can you drop the pool id + invoice id? I'll pull metering.

alex.park: pool rp-nyc-3, invoice inv-2023-11-30-ACME, customer reported spike between 00:00-06:00 UTC.

ryan.c: pulling metering now. quick thought: could be prewarm/warmup instances counted as reserved hours but not attributed to token meter. :thinking: 

billing-bot: Metering snapshot for rp-nyc-3 (00:00-06:00 UTC): reserved_hours=119.6, billed_hours=119.6, token_count=4012, embedding_units=0. See internal link: https://infra.redwood/metering/rp-nyc-3

jen-sre: Can we run `redwood-meter query --pool rp-nyc-3 --range 2023-11-30T00:00Z/2023-11-30T06:00Z --granularity 5m --events` and paste output? Looking for instance lifecycle events + warmup jobs.

ryan.c: pasted results:
```
2023-11-30T00:12Z instance-prewarm id=inst-873 state=running owner=warmup-job
auto-scale: created 12 prewarm instances
2023-11-30T00:13Z request-fallback id=req-431 failed -> routed to prewarm
2023-11-30T05:59Z warmup-job cleanup failed code=504
```
Looks like cleanup never completed; instances stayed counted for full 6h window.

maria.g: that explains reserved_hours vs token_count — prewarm instances do not process inference, so token meter stays low while reserved_hour meter counts instance uptime.

alex.park: Customer is upset and asking for credit. Any SLA credit eligibility here? It wasn't an outage but definitely unexpected billing.

billing-ops: We can do a manual adjustment. Need customer consent + approver. I propose crediting hours beyond the baseline prewarm policy. Suggest credit = 116.0 hours. Will prepare approval request to finance. tagging @finance 

jen-sre: Root cause: warmup-job cleanup path hit a retry/timeout bug when transient NFS latency occurred. Cleanup hung and instances stayed in running state. Filed RN-4123: "warmup cleanup can hang on NFS timeout". Patch queued for deploy. Also adding alert: prewarm-instances > expected for >10m.

ryan.c: action items: (1) billing-ops to prepare credit (2) infra to deploy RN-4123 patch (3) devex to add wording in docs about prewarm billing semantics (4) ops to run one-time reconciliation script across active pools.

alex.park: I updated the customer and asked for approval to apply credit. They replied: "Yes please credit, and let us know when fixed." :thumbsup:

billing-ops: Credit applied: 116.0 hours on inv-2023-11-30-ACME. credit id cr-8821. Invoice updated and customer notified.

jen-sre: Deploy of RN-4123 completed 2023-12-01T09:20Z. Monitoring alert and dashboard tile added. Patch notes: ensure warmup cleanup retries are bounded + fail-safe graceful termination.

alex.park: thanks all — please add a short postmortem to the ticket and close.

billing-bot: Support ticket support-7891 closed. Adjustment CR-8821 applied. Bug RN-4123 tracked. :white_check_mark:
